label: Bible Study
prompt: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am _____.
verse: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
note: Mountain-moving faith without love adds up to exactly nothing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he hath put a new _____ in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verse: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
note: Lifted out of the miry clay, David gets a new song in his mouth — and others start trusting too.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the _____:
verse: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
note: The foolish builder heard the very same sermon; his only mistake was not doing it — and great was the fall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Neither is there any _____ betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verse: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
note: A daysman is an arbiter who lays a hand on both parties — Job longed for one between him and God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always _____ with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verse: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
note: Before the flood, God set a limit: 'My spirit shall not always strive with man' — his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
